facts.text: The Husky Promise guarantees that full tuition and standard fees are covered by grant or scholarship support for eligible Washington state students who meet Pell Grant eligibility criteria.

sources.quote: The Husky Promise guarantees full tuition and standard fees will be covered by grant or scholarship support for eligible Washington state students.

sources.title: Husky Promise | Student Financial Aid & Scholarships | University of Washington Tacoma
sources.quote: In general, the Husky Promise is available to UW students at all three campuses – Bothell, Seattle and Tacoma – who are Washington state residents and meet the eligibility criteria for the Pell Grant.
